purpose: Determine whether the single public MS2137 MUSE level-2 cube can provide a source-traceable, covariance-bearing stellar-dynamics profile through 14 arcsec (64.20 kpc), overlapping four strong-lens image positions from three source families.
blindness_rule: The cube, center, annuli, source mask, spectral range, templates, polynomial orders, resolution treatment, S/N and consistency thresholds, covariance construction, and stop rules are frozen before reading a DATA or STAT array. Published MS2137 dispersions may be used only as a post-decision diagnostic and no gravity or lens residual is an input.

input.spectral_range_limitation: This pre-pixel acquisition uses the established project observed-frame 4860-7160-A range. At z=0.313 it does not reproduce the paper's stated rest-frame 4860-7160-A fit; it instead retains the Ca H+K, G-band, H-beta, and Mg-b-region absorption information available in rest 3702-5453 A. The limitation is part of the final decision and cannot be repaired post-result by silently changing bands.
input.astrometric_registration: Fit a robust fixed-n=4.05 circular Sersic continuum model near the WCS-predicted BCG position and treat the fitted offset as a global cube-WCS correction.

spatial_extraction.geometry_rationale: Use circular annuli as in the published MS2137 MUSE analysis and as a theory-neutral structural gate. The inner boundaries retain the published 0.5-arcsec cadence; progressively wider outer annuli trade radial resolution for S/N without moving the frozen 14-arcsec edge.

mask_protocol.stage_1: Mask non-finite DATA/STAT samples and non-positive variance.
mask_protocol.stage_2: Construct a white-light image as the median of native planes from 6000-7000 Angstrom.
mask_protocol.stage_3: Subtract a 3-pixel Gaussian-smoothed white-light image to form a compact-source detection image.
mask_protocol.stage_4: In the 3-17 arcsec reference zone, flag positive connected components 2-300 pixels in area above 6 robust sigma.
mask_protocol.stage_5: Dilate accepted components by 8 pixels; never mask the registered central 3 arcsec through this compact-source rule; freeze the resulting mask for every baseline, half-field, bootstrap, and sensitivity fit.

spectral_fit.template_resolution_rationale: XSL is the resolution-valid baseline. E-MILES is broader than the MUSE rest-frame instrumental FWHM over much of this band and is retained only as a conservative template-plus-resolution diagnostic.
spectral_fit.polynomial_rationale: These orders are the published MS2137-specific choices: fifth-order additive and third-order multiplicative.
spectral_fit.noise_model: Sum STAT variance over unmasked spaxels and rescale conditional pPXF errors by square root of reduced chi-square. Spatial block bootstrap carries the measured pixel-noise realization into the covariance.

spatial_block_bootstrap.configuration: XSL, instrumental FWHM 2.6 Angstrom, high-variance mask 6 sigma

covariance_protocol.construction: Add the unbiased 100-vector block-bootstrap covariance to the mean outer product of the five predeclared one-factor shifts from the frozen XSL baseline. Preserve all 9x9 off-diagonal terms. The four cross-combinations enter the maximum-shift gate but are not overweighted in the systematic covariance.

decision_rule: Promote MS2137 to a numerical same-system dynamics pilot only if P1-P4 all pass and the accepted covariance-bearing profile reaches the unchanged 14.0-arcsec edge. A failed outer bin, one-sided inconsistency, incomplete bootstrap, non-PSD covariance, or greater-than-10-percent systematic shift closes this attempt. Do not shrink support to 6.8 or 3.34 arcsec, merge bins after seeing their spectra, change templates, lower S/N, or compare to the published dispersion curve to tune a rerun.
